scenarios.title: Book Search by Title
scenarios.description: Verify that users can search for books by title
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book search functionality using a book title as the search parameter
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple books with different titles exist in the library database
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the library search page
2. Select 'Title' as the search parameter
3. Enter a known book title (e.g., 'The Great Gatsby')
4. Click the 'Search' button
scenarios.expectedResult: All books matching the search title are displayed in the search results

scenarios.title: Book Search by Author
scenarios.description: Verify that users can search for books by author name
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book search functionality using an author name as the search parameter
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple books by different authors exist in the library database
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the library search page
2. Select 'Author' as the search parameter
3. Enter a known author name (e.g., 'J.K. Rowling')
4. Click the 'Search' button
scenarios.expectedResult: All books by the specified author are displayed in the search results

scenarios.title: Book Search by ISBN
scenarios.description: Verify that users can search for books by ISBN
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book search functionality using an ISBN as the search parameter
scenarios.prerequisites: Books with unique ISBNs exist in the library database
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the library search page
2. Select 'ISBN' as the search parameter
3. Enter a known ISBN (e.g., '978-0-306-40615-7')
4. Click the 'Search' button
scenarios.expectedResult: The specific book matching the ISBN is displayed in the search results

scenarios.title: Book Checkout by Valid User
scenarios.description: Verify that registered users can check out available books
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book checkout process for a user with valid credentials and borrowing privileges
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User is registered in the system
2. User has valid borrowing privileges
3. Book is available for checkout
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with valid user credentials
2. Search for an available book
3. Select the book from search results
4. Click the 'Checkout' button
5. Confirm the checkout action
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System displays confirmation message
2. Book status changes to 'Checked Out'
3. Book appears in user's borrowed items list
4. Due date is set according to library policy

scenarios.title: Book Return Process
scenarios.description: Verify that books can be properly returned to the library
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book return process for a previously checked out book
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User has at least one book checked out
2. The book's due date has not passed
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with valid user credentials
2. Navigate to 'My Borrowed Items' section
3. Select a checked out book
4. Click the 'Return' button
5. Confirm the return action
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System displays return confirmation message
2. Book status changes to 'Available'
3. Book is removed from user's borrowed items list

scenarios.title: Book Renewal Process
scenarios.description: Verify that users can renew borrowed books before the due date
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book renewal process for a checked out book that is eligible for renewal
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User has at least one book checked out
2. The book is eligible for renewal (has not reached maximum renewals)
3. The book's due date has not passed
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with valid user credentials
2. Navigate to 'My Borrowed Items' section
3. Select a checked out book
4. Click the 'Renew' button
5. Confirm the renewal action
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System displays renewal confirmation message
2. Book's due date is extended according to library policy
3. Renewal count for the book is incremented

scenarios.title: Late Return Fee Calculation
scenarios.description: Verify that appropriate late fees are calculated for overdue books
scenarios.testDescription: Test the late fee calculation for books returned after the due date
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User has at least one overdue book
2. System date is set to be after the book's due date
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with valid user credentials
2. Navigate to 'My Borrowed Items' section
3. Return an overdue book by clicking 'Return' and confirming
4. Navigate to 'My Account' or 'Fees' section
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. Late fee is calculated correctly based on the number of days overdue
2. Fee amount is displayed in the user's account
3. Return confirmation includes information about the late fee

scenarios.title: User Registration
scenarios.description: Verify that new users can register for a library account
scenarios.testDescription: Test the user registration process with valid information
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the library registration page
2. Enter required personal information (name, address, email, phone)
3. Create username and password
4. Accept terms and conditions
5. Submit registration form
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System creates a new user account
2. Confirmation message is displayed
3. User receives confirmation email
4. User can log in with the new credentials

scenarios.title: Book Reservation
scenarios.description: Verify that users can reserve books that are currently checked out
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book reservation process for a book that is currently unavailable
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User is registered in the system
2. Target book is currently checked out by another user
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with valid user credentials
2. Search for a book that is currently checked out
3. Select the book from search results
4. Click the 'Reserve' button
5. Confirm the reservation
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System displays reservation confirmation
2. Book appears in user's reservation list
3. User is placed in the reservation queue for the book

scenarios.title: Book Recommendation System
scenarios.description: Verify that the system recommends books based on user's borrowing history
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book recommendation functionality for users with borrowing history
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User has previously borrowed books
2. Recommendation system is enabled
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with valid user credentials
2. Navigate to the 'Recommended Books' section
3. Observe the list of recommended books
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System displays book recommendations based on user's borrowing history
2. Recommendations are relevant to user's reading preferences
3. Each recommendation includes book details and availability status

scenarios.title: Book Checkout Limit Enforcement
scenarios.description: Verify that the system enforces maximum book checkout limits
scenarios.testDescription: Test that users cannot exceed the maximum allowed number of borrowed books
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User is registered in the system
2. User has borrowed the maximum allowed number of books
3. At least one more book is available for checkout
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with valid user credentials
2. Search for an available book
3. Select the book from search results
4. Attempt to check out the book
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System prevents the checkout action
2. System displays an error message indicating the maximum checkout limit has been reached
3. Book remains available for other users

scenarios.title: Advanced Search with Multiple Parameters
scenarios.description: Verify that users can search using combinations of search criteria
scenarios.testDescription: Test the advanced search functionality using multiple search parameters simultaneously
scenarios.prerequisites: Multiple books with various attributes exist in the library database
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the advanced search page
2. Enter an author name in the author field
3. Select a publication year range
4. Select a genre from the dropdown
5. Click the 'Search' button
scenarios.expectedResult: Search results display only books that match all specified criteria (author, publication year range, and genre)

scenarios.title: Password Reset Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify that users can reset their forgotten passwords
scenarios.testDescription: Test the password reset process for registered users
scenarios.prerequisites: User account exists in the system with a valid email address
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the login page
2. Click on 'Forgot Password' link
3. Enter the registered email address
4. Submit the form
5. Check email for reset link
6. Click on the reset link
7. Enter new password
8. Confirm new password
9. Submit the password reset form
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. Reset link is sent to the user's email
2. User can access the password reset page through the link
3. After setting a new password, user can log in with the new credentials
4. System confirms successful password change

scenarios.title: User Profile Update
scenarios.description: Verify that users can update their profile information
scenarios.testDescription: Test the functionality that allows users to update their personal information
scenarios.prerequisites: User is registered and logged into the system
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'My Account' or 'Profile' section
2. Click on 'Edit Profile' option
3. Update information (e.g., phone number, address, email)
4. Save changes
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System saves the updated information
2. Profile displays the newly updated information
3. System confirms successful update with a notification

scenarios.title: Book Review Submission
scenarios.description: Verify that users can submit reviews for books they have borrowed
scenarios.testDescription: Test the book review submission functionality
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. User is registered and logged into the system
2. User has previously borrowed the book they want to review
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the 'My Borrowed History' section
2. Select a book from the history
3. Click on 'Write a Review'
4. Enter a rating (e.g., 1-5 stars)
5. Enter review text
6. Submit the review
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. System saves the review
2. Review appears on the book's details page
3. System confirms successful submission with a notification
